svg.title: Wall-time performance profile for jointly optimal B&B instances
svg.desc: Performance profile over 365 instances solved optimally by all seven methods. The horizontal axis is wall time divided by the fastest method on each instance, on a logarithmic scale. The vertical axis is the fraction of instances completed within that factor. Color identifies the search method, while line style identifies the LP configuration.
svg.text: Performance profile on 365 jointly optimal J30 instances
Wall-time factor relative to fastest method (log scale)
